svg.title: 2025 Falcon launch mix
svg.desc: Of 165 Falcon launches in 2025, SpaceX classified 122 as internal and 43 as customer launches. Shares are 73.9% and 26.1%, rounded to one decimal place. Customer designation depends on the primary payload and mission requirements. Starship flights are excluded.
